defs.def: a person's male child 儿子

ex.s: Not long ago, my fifth-grade son Kevin asked me about the meaning of a word in a novel.
ex.t: 不久前，我上五年级的儿子凯文问我一本小说里一个词的意思。

ex.s: Now I understand that although my son may be learning differently, he is still learning.
ex.t: 现在我明白，虽然儿子的学习方式可能不同，但他仍然在学习。

ex.s: In the headmaster’s office, my father listened attentively, and then spoke with quiet authority: “I trust my son.
ex.t: 在校长办公室里，父亲专注地听着，然后以沉静的威严说道：“我相信我的儿子。”

ex.s: "He saved my   64   （son）life," said Mrs Brown.
ex.t: "他救了我   64  （son）的命，"Brown太太说。

ex.s: When she retired from dancing and her sons eventually flew the nest, she decided it was time to take the plunge.
ex.t: 当她从舞蹈事业退休，儿子们最终离巢后，她决定是时候迈出这一步了。

ex.s: Parting from his son.
ex.t: 与儿子分别。

ex.s: Parting from his son.
ex.t: 与他的儿子告别。

ex.s: A couple of years ago, film-maker David Bond realised that his children, then aged five and three, were attached to screens to the point where he was able to say "chocolate" into his three-year-old son’s ear without getting a response.
ex.t: 影片制作人大卫·邦德(David Bond)在几年前意识到，他的孩子当时五岁三岁，被贴在屏幕上，以至于他可以在三岁的儿子的耳朵里说"巧克力"而没有得到回应。

ex.s: Three of the four Lincoln sons were born here.
ex.t: 四个林肯儿子中有三个出生在这里。

ex.s: Then one Christmas I received a surprise gift—a large, beautifully made wooden chest My son Bruce had made my Grandma's Box a reality.
ex.t: 后来有一年圣诞节，我收到一份惊喜礼物——一只大而精美的木箱。我儿子布鲁斯让我的“奶奶的箱子”变成了现实。

ex.s: “That’s the garden in our picture,”Nicolo’s son told his father.
ex.t: "那就是我们画里的花园，"Nicolo的儿子告诉他的父亲。

ex.s: They had driven their son several hours out of town to the university where he would soon be living and studying.
ex.t: 他们开了几个小时的车把儿子送到城外的大学，他很快就将在那里生活和学习。

ex.s: Her owners were sad too, but they knew their son would be back to visit.
ex.t: 它的主人也很伤心，但他们知道儿子会回来看望它。

ex.s: One of the most stressful days of Susan McFrederick's life was watching her son get wheeled away for surgery hours after he was born in 2011.
ex.t: Susan McFrederick一生中最有压力的日子之一就是看着她的儿子在2011年出生几小时后被推去做手术。

ex.s: After we returned to the hotel late in the afternoon, my 7-year-old son Ponder   13   that nowhere could he find his backpack, which   14   his Gameboy and his watch.
ex.t: 下午晚些时候我们回到酒店后，我7岁的儿子Ponder____13____发现他到处都找不到他的背包，里面____14____他的Gameboy和手表。

ex.s: A son of immigrants, Chris stared learning English a little over three years ago.
ex.t: 作为移民的儿子，克里斯在三年多一点前才开始学习英语。

ex.s: Your son may not be the best basketball player on his team.
ex.t: 你儿子也许不是队里最好的篮球运动员。

ex.s: （1分）﹣My son got a full scholarship to his dream university!
ex.t: 6．（1分）—我儿子拿到了梦想大学的全额奖学金！

ex.s: And the Good Morning Britain presenter says she’s been able to put a lot of what she’s leant into practice in her own home, preparing meals for sons, Sam, 14, Finn, 13, and Jack, 11.
ex.t: 这位《早安英国》主持人说，她已能把学到的很多东西付诸自家实践，为14岁的萨姆、13岁的芬恩和11岁的杰克三个儿子做饭。

ex.s: Two weeks earlier, my son, Ben, had got in touch.
ex.t: 两周前，我的儿子Ben联系上你了

ex.s: That stranger was my son!
ex.t: 那个陌生人是我儿子！

ex.s: I’m just so glad I was there   60   to help my son.
ex.t: 我很高兴我在60岁的时候帮助了我的儿子。

ex.s: Yesterday, I sat with my son, Shepherd, determined to test my own theory on this.
ex.t: 昨天，我和儿子 Shepherd 坐在一起，决心用自己的理论测试这一点。

ex.s: His wife Tina cooked us a delicious dinner and we got to know his sons Ryan and Kyle.
ex.t: 他的妻子蒂娜为我们做了一顿美味的晚餐，我们认识了她的儿子瑞恩和凯尔。

ex.s: This brief visit with Mother Nature cost me two days off from work, recovering from a bad case of sunburn and the doctor’s bill for my son’s food poisoning.
ex.t: 这次与大自然的短暂接触让我请了两天假，还因为严重的晒伤和儿子食物中毒的医药费而恢复了好一阵子。

ex.s: I hadn’t, until one day my five-year-old son asked me whether there was ham in a hamburger.
ex.t: 我一直没想过，直到有一天我五岁的儿子问我汉堡里有没有火腿。

ex.s: Like Father, Like Son (The living room.
ex.t: 如父亲，如儿子(客厅).

ex.s: (Son enters room.) Father: Not again!
ex.t: （儿子进了房间。）父亲：别又来了！

ex.s: Son: (nervously approaching the table) Erm...Dad, can we talk?
ex.t: 儿子： （紧张地走近桌子）呃……爸爸，我们能谈谈吗？

ex.s: Son: I knew you'd say that.
ex.t: 我就知道你会这么说

ex.s: In my ninth-grade writing class last year, I met a cowboy who saved his town, a strict father who demanded his son earn straight A’s, and a modern-day Juliet who died of heartbreak after her parents rejected the love of her young life.
ex.t: 去年在我九年级的写作课上，我遇到了一个拯救了小镇的牛仔、一个要求儿子门门得A的严厉父亲，以及一个在现代版朱丽叶——她在父母拒绝了她年轻生命中的挚爱后，因心碎而死。

defs.def: （年长者对年轻男子或男孩的爱称）孩子

ex.s: Matt Hunt said he was "very proud" of his son because “when the boy gets an idea, he keeps his head down and gets on with it, and he really does want to do some good and stop young kids from getting asthma."
ex.t: 马特·亨特说他为儿子感到“非常自豪”，因为“当男孩有了想法时，他会埋头苦干，坚持下去，而且他真的想做点好事，防止孩子们患上哮喘。”
